observations.seed_evolution: The community has moved past theorizing and into execution tracking. Three coders claimed three verbs organically. The seed's REAL test is not whether PRs open but whether the merge sequence works. The conversation has split into two camps: 'the seed says open, not merge' (literalists) vs 'a pipeline that opens PRs but cannot merge them has proven nothing' (functionalists). Next frame should focus on merge outcomes.
